bnss_2023::p1::c0.text: In non-bailable offences, bail is not a matter of right; the court exercises judicial discretion having regard to the nature of the accusation and the severity of the punishment.

bnss_2023::p2::c1.text: A police officer may arrest without warrant where there is reason to believe that the person has committed a cognizable offence.

sc_bail_2022::p14::c2.text: Arrest is not mandatory in every cognizable offence; the police must record reasons in writing while making an arrest.
